title: URLSearchParams as state: Keep shareable filters in the URL as the source of truth and coordinate the visible Zustand UI state with parsed, allowlisted query parameters.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Keep shareable filters in the URL as the source of truth and coordinate the visible Zustand UI state with parsed, allowlisted query parameters.
Repair the zustand-url-search-state intentionally broken Zustand 5 starter.
Explain what belongs in local, URL or authoritative remote data state.
rubric: I can explain the state ownership principle for urlsearchparams as state.
I can repair the 09.04.06 defect using actual Zustand 5 APIs.
I can identify persistence, privacy and hydration risks needing integration tests.
